notes.title: Avadon 3 v1.0.2 Update Available
notes.content:
We continue to relentlessly push Avadon 3 toward protection! This update fixes a number of issues ...

* All special combat bonuses bought from townsfolk work correctly now.
* The Macintosh version will launch on OS X 10.6. (Though it is not officially supported on this version of the OS.)
* Descriptions of Medals corrected.
* Exploit for High Lord Golath fight fixed.
* You can’t kill innocent townsfolk with ground effects anymore.
* A number of minor issues and typos.

notes.title: Avadon 3 v1.0.1 Update Available
notes.content:
We have release the v1.0.1 update for Avadon 3: The Warborn. Changes include:

* Each point of intelligence now has a chance of giving summoned turrets another level.
* Tooltips for blesses and curses are clearer.
* Other character abilities rebalanced.
* Nature Mastery now increases health, reverting it back to its role in Avadon 1 & 2.
* An exploit using floor damage effects has been removed.
* Miklosh no longer dies when Vanatok’s Stead is attacked.


Enjoy!
